name: fi-company-formation
description: Prepare an ordinary Finnish private limited company formation in 2026 using the current PRH online routes. Distinguish guided setup from drafted-document filing, authority fees from share capital, and registration from tax obligations. Screen board composition and EEA residence, preserve the incorporation deadline, and prepare the ordinary audit-size and annual filing checks. Use for Oy formation, Finnish Trade Register registration, setup fees, directors, deputy directors, financial statement filing or audit thresholds. Includes statutory and authority sources, read dates and worked controls. Other entities, exemptions, specialist sectors and named Finnish accountant review remain open.
